comparison.objective: Candidate commissions a shock absorber by unlocking, tuning, relocking, and testing dynamic carriage response; record selects a wrench, loosens a captive latch nut, opens an arm, and verifies a hands-free hold.
comparison.physical_skill: Some overlap in tool fitting, fastener loosening, damage avoidance, and manipulation after release. The candidate additionally requires recessed hex-key insertion, bimanual counterholding, fine collar adjustment, bounded retightening, physical cycle actuation, and response-driven iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe physical cycles within stroke, impact, rebound, overload, and post-lock drift limits. Record requires an undamaged nut, released/open arm, and 20-second contact-free hold. Its structured specs and detailed native rubric thresholds are absent from the record file.
comparison.reason: Shared fastener primitives do not make the tested abilities equivalent: dynamic damper tuning and verified lock retention are meaningfully different from releasing a latch and holding its arm open.
